Class Player

java.lang.Object
Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents the player character in the world map.

Handles sprite animation, tile-based grid movement, and terrain collision detection. Movement is initiated externally (via InputHandler) by setting targetX/targetY; the update() method interpolates toward the target each game tick.

    • Player

      public Player(int pixelX, int pixelY, int row, int tileSize)
      Creates a player at an exact pixel position loaded from a save file.
      Parameters:
      pixelX - saved pixel X position
      pixelY - saved pixel Y position
      row - sprite sheet row representing the facing direction
      tileSize - pixel size of one tile (used for movement calculations)

    • setDirection

      public void setDirection(int row, int width, int height, int xOffset, int gap)
      Sets the sprite sheet parameters for the current facing direction.
      Parameters:
      row - sprite sheet Y offset for the direction row
      width - frame width in pixels
      height - frame height in pixels
      xOffset - X offset of the first frame within the sheet
      gap - pixel gap between consecutive frames
